def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the full-height divider column.
    divider = next(
        c for c in range(w)
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1
    )

    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    width = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))

    # The non-match color is the background color of the right panel.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(cell for row in right for cell in row[:width])
    right_background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    return [
        [3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else right_background
         for c in range(width)]
        for r in range(h)
    ]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the uniform line separating two equal-sized panels.
    sep = None
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and r * 2 + 1 == h:
            sep = ("row", r)
            break
    if sep is None:
        for c in range(w):
            if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and c * 2 + 1 == w:
                sep = ("col", c)
                break

    if sep[0] == "row":
        _, r = sep
        a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
        common = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
        color = next(iter(common))
        return [[3 if a[i][j] == color and b[i][j] == color else color
                 for j in range(w)] for i in range(r)]

    _, c = sep
    left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
    right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
    common = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
    color = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if left[i][j] == color and right[i][j] == color else color
             for j in range(c)] for i in range(h)]
